mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, session_external_id, resource_type, secret_payload, CAST(NULL AS text) AS file_external_id, CAST(NULL AS text) AS file_path, CAST(NULL AS text) AS file_ownership, github_repository_url, github_repository_checkout, mount_path, memory_store_uuid, CAST(NULL AS text) AS memory_store_external_id, memory_access, memory_description, memory_instructions, memory_name, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at

resource.uuid AS uuid, resource.external_id AS external_id, resource.organization_uuid AS organization_uuid, resource.workspace_uuid AS workspace_uuid, resource.session_uuid AS session_uuid, resource.session_external_id AS session_external_id, resource.resource_type AS resource_type, resource.secret_payload AS secret_payload, file.external_id AS file_external_id, resource.path AS file_path, resource.file_ownership AS file_ownership, resource.github_repository_url AS github_repository_url, resource.github_repository_checkout AS github_repository_checkout, resource.mount_path AS mount_path, resource.memory_store_uuid AS memory_store_uuid, memory_store.external_id AS memory_store_external_id, resource.memory_access AS memory_access, resource.memory_description AS memory_description, resource.memory_instructions AS memory_instructions, resource.memory_name AS memory_name, resource.created_at AS created_at, resource.updated_at AS updated_at, resource.deleted_at AS deleted_at

AND ( ( resource.resource_type = 'file' AND file.uuid IS NOT NULL AND file.deleted_at IS NULL AND (resource.expires_at IS NULL OR resource.expires_at > now()) AND ( (resource.file_ownership = 'referenced' AND left(resource.path, char_length('/uploads/')) = '/uploads/') OR (resource.file_ownership = 'owned' AND left(resource.path, char_length('/outputs/')) = '/outputs/') ) ) OR ( resource.resource_type = 'github_repository' AND resource.github_repository_url IS NOT NULL AND resource.mount_path IS NOT NULL ) OR (resource.resource_type = 'memory_store' AND memory_store.uuid IS NOT NULL) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_resources ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, session_external_id, resource_type, secret_payload, github_repository_url, github_repository_checkout, mount_path, memory_store_uuid, memory_access, memory_description, memory_instructions, memory_name, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, s.uuid, #{params.SessionExternalID}, #{params.ResourceType}, CAST(#{params.SecretPayload,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.GitHubURL}, CAST(#{params.GitHubCheckout} AS jsonb), #{params.MountPath}, memory_store.uuid, #{params.MemoryAccess}, #{params.MemoryDescription}, #{params.MemoryInstructions}, #{params.MemoryName}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN memory_stores memory_store ON memory_store.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid AND memory_store.external_id = #{params.MemoryStoreID} AND memory_store.deleted_at IS NULL AND memory_store.archived_at IS NULL WHERE s.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND s.external_id = #{params.SessionExternalID} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.archived_at IS NULL AND (#{params.ResourceType} <> 'memory_store' OR memory_store.uuid IS NOT NULL) RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM session_resources resource LEFT JOIN files file ON file.uuid = resource.file_uuid AND file.workspace_uuid = resource.workspace_uuid LEFT JOIN memory_stores memory_store ON memory_store.uuid = resource.memory_store_uuid AND memory_store.workspace_uuid = resource.workspace_uuid WHERE resource.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND resource.session_external_id = #{sessionExternalID} AND resource.external_id = #{resourceExternalID} AND resource.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM session_resources resource LEFT JOIN files file ON file.uuid = resource.file_uuid AND file.workspace_uuid = resource.workspace_uuid LEFT JOIN memory_stores memory_store ON memory_store.uuid = resource.memory_store_uuid AND memory_store.workspace_uuid = resource.workspace_uuid WHERE resource.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND resource.session_external_id = #{sessionExternalID} AND resource.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY resource.created_at DESC, resource.uuid DESC

SELECT resource.path FROM session_resources resource CROSS JOIN (VALUES (CAST(#{params.EntryPath} AS text))) AS candidate(path) WHERE resource.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND resource.session_uuid = #{params.SessionUUID} AND resource.file_ownership = 'referenced' AND resource.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( resource.path = candidate.path OR left(resource.path, length(candidate.path) + 1) = concat(candidate.path, '/') OR left(candidate.path, length(resource.path) + 1) = concat(resource.path, '/') ) ORDER BY resource.path LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_resources ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, session_external_id, resource_type, secret_payload, path, parent_path, file_ownership, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{params.ResourceUUID}, #{params.ResourceExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, session.uuid, session.external_id, 'directory', NULL, #{params.EntryPath}, #{params.ParentPath}, NULL, #{params.Now}, #{params.Now} FROM sessions session WHERE session.uuid = #{params.SessionUUID} AND session.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND session.deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id

WITH inserted_file AS ( INSERT INTO files ( uuid, external_id, workspace_uuid, filename, mime_type, detected_mime_type, size_bytes, metadata, authorization_metadata, tags, downloadable, md5, sha256, s3_bucket, s3_key, s3_etag, s3_version_id, scope_type, scope_id, created_by_api_key_uuid, created_at ) SELECT #{params.FileUUID}, #{params.FileExternalID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.Filename}, #{params.MediaType}, #{params.DetectedMimeType}, #{params.SizeBytes}, CAST(#{params.Metadata} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.AuthorizationMetadata} AS jsonb), #{params.Tags}, #{params.Downloadable}, #{params.MD5}, #{params.SHA256}, #{params.S3Bucket}, #{params.S3Key}, #{params.S3ETag}, #{params.S3VersionID}, 'session', session.external_id, COALESCE(api_key.uuid, session.created_by_api_key_uuid), #{params.Now} FROM sessions session LEFT JOIN api_keys api_key ON api_key.uuid = #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID} AND api_key.workspace_uuid = session.workspace_uuid WHERE session.uuid = #{params.SessionUUID} AND session.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND session.deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING uuid ) INSERT INTO session_resources ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, session_external_id, resource_type, secret_payload, path, parent_path, mount_path, file_uuid, file_ownership, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{params.ResourceUUID}, #{params.ResourceExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, session.uuid, session.external_id, 'file', NULL, #{params.EntryPath}, #{params.ParentPath}, #{params.EntryPath}, inserted_file.uuid, 'owned', #{params.ExpiresAt}, #{params.Now}, #{params.Now} FROM inserted_file JOIN sessions session ON session.uuid = #{params.SessionUUID} RETURNING id
